text:
The night crew brought up a thought on hand-off notes, and thank you for your short note. We understand your complaint that your companion animal's transfer and care updates did not meet the standard expected from Aurelia Skyways. That gap is not acceptable, and the Companion Animal Travel Desk is treating it as a service failure that needs prompt correction.

We have reviewed the file with the welfare coordinator and the ground team, and the concern appears to have been a breakdown in the exchange of welfare details between services. The animal was handled by staff trained in careful carrier movement, but the communication around comfort checks, escort responsibility, and status updates should have been clearer. We are reinforcing the hand-off steps now so the next team receives a full welfare summary without delay.

Please be assured that companion animal welfare remains a priority, not an afterthought. If you need a further review, we will gather the relevant records, confirm the transfer path, and address any missed detail directly with the station team involved. We also want to restore confidence in our process, because travelers should not have to chase basic care information for a pet in our custody.

Thank you for raising this promptly. Your feedback helps us tighten routine desk work and keep standards steady across Aurelia Skyways.

Companion Animal Travel Desk
